description: Makes live TLS connections to a host and reports the certificate chain, expiry, protocol versions, cipher strength and common misconfigurations. Ports 443, 8443, 465, 993 and 995.

host.description: A public host name such as example.com.

port.description: Port to check, one of 443, 8443, 465, 993, 995. Defaults to 443.

name: ssl_check
title: SSL certificate checker
